text:
rachel: quick patch opened to correct /v1/embeddings example. it currently shows "input" as a string which confuses users about batching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

kevin: paste the snippet that needs changing?

rachel: current page shows:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-small-1",
  "input": "single doc text"
}
```
proposed change: show an array to make batch semantics clear:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "embed-small-1",
  "input": ["single doc text", "another doc"]
}
```
Also added a short note: responses return `data` as an array in the same order as inputs.

docs-bot: linter flagged openapi.components.schemas.EmbeddingsRequest.example.input type mismatch (expected array, found string). CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/1601/logs/77 :warning:

sam: nice catch. update OpenAPI example and the snippet generator so it doesn't collapse single-item arrays to strings. there's a template that special-cases length 1.

kevin: i'll change the template and the YAML example. also add a small docs-test asserting rendered HTML contains `"input": ["single doc text"]` to avoid regressions.

rachel: pushed the OpenAPI fix and test. running CI.

docs-bot: CI passed on branch fix/embeds-array-examples (build 601) :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood-inference/1601/builds/601

sam: merged. support asked for a tiny migration note about SDKs auto-wrapping strings; i added a one-line snippet for Python and Go in the migration docs.

rachel: thanks all, closing thread.
